title: ALiBi: the nearer word wins
notes: On content alone, it matches dog better than ball (1.41 against 0.78). But dog is 5 steps back and ball 2, so the biases are −2.5 and −1. With them ball gets 0.36 of the weight and dog 0.15. ALiBi bets that nearer words matter more: often right, not always.
